visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a woman with long black hair, wearing a dark brown turtleneck sweater. She holds a Chanel double-ended lipstick vertically near her cheek. A sharp shadow bisects her face diagonally, creating a dramatic lighting effect. She gazes into the camera with a subtle, poised smile. (2) In the next scene, she is indoors against a plain white background, now wearing a grey off-the-shoulder top. She enthusiastically holds a white Chanel shopping bag and then reveals three Chanel lipstick boxes in her other hand. Her expression is bright and welcoming as she speaks directly to the viewer. (3) The camera zooms in significantly on her hand to demonstrate the product's texture. She opens the colored liquid end of the dual-ended lipstick and applies a thick, rosy-brown swatch onto the back of her hand. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the pigment's saturation and physical state. (4) She then applies the same liquid lipstick color directly to her own lips using the built-in sponge wand. The background remains the neutral white studio setting. Her movements are slow and precise as she outlines her lips, while text subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. (5) After the base color dries, she demonstrates the second end of the tube, which contains a clear moisturizing gloss. She applies it over the matte base, visibly transforming her lip texture from a velvety finish to a high-shine, glossy look. She tilts her head slightly to capture light reflections. (6) A brief cutaway shows her in a different environment, wearing a black jacket and a pearl necklace, possibly inside a car. She touches her lips with her index finger and shows it to the camera to prove the transfer-proof quality. Her lighting here is more natural and diffused. (7) Returning to the indoor studio, she concludes her review while holding the lipstick. She uses various hand gestures, including holding up two fingers, to emphasize points about lip lines and moisture. She maintains consistent eye contact and a helpful, informative facial expression throughout the closing remarks.
